references.text: Isaiah prophesied about this phenomenon, which Jesus refers to in order to explain why some people can see and hear spiritual truths while others cannot.
This verse expresses a desire to be able to see wonderful things from God's law, which resonates with the idea of having eyes that see and ears that hear in a spiritual sense.
Paul quotes Isaiah to explain why some people do not understand the gospel, reflecting Jesus' words about having eyes that see and ears that hear.
